headline: Anand Rathi sees AI integration opportunity for Indian IT firms
hook: AI software demand surges for enterprise integration
summary: Anthropic reported a 14-fold revenue increase in the first half of 2026, signaling rapid enterprise AI adoption. Brokerage firm Anand Rathi suggests Indian IT companies are well-positioned to benefit by integrating these AI systems into client business operations. This approach allows IT firms to capture value without the heavy capital expenditure required for building underlying computing infrastructure. Indian retail investors should note this as a potential long-term growth driver for the domestic IT services sector.
why_it_matters: Indian IT firms may see new revenue streams from AI integration services.
winners_losers: IT services firms gain / Infrastructure providers neutral

headline: Anthropic revenue soars 14-fold in H1 2026, sparking debate over gains for Indian IT giants like TCS, Infosys, and HCL Tech
